systems.country_label: Nascer com o Registo; campanha de registo nas maternidades
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos with the Ministério da Saúde
systems.tiers: maternities, where Justice staff working in rotation make the registration; for remote communities with no birth registration service the project foresees 'livros de cadastro'. No count of maternities and no statement of whether the record is digital

systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos, under a protocol with the Ministério da Educação signed 1 June 2018
systems.tiers: launched 16 June 2018 at a primary school in Cazenga, Luanda; to run nationally each January

systems.country_label: Bilhete de Identidade Integrado; novo sistema de emissão dos bilhetes de identidade
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça e dos Direitos Humanos
systems.tiers: data captured at the repartições de identificação civil e criminal; launched 20 November 2017 at the Samba post, Luanda; a second phase is to integrate the taxpayer, social security and voter numbers and the birth bulletin

note: The bulletin counts civil registry output for 2017 to 2018 (1,846,954 acts in the Conservatórias do Registo Civil; 1,049,825 birth entries, 37,028 death entries, 6,017 marriage entries) and describes the maternity and school registration programmes, but nowhere says how the record is made, on paper or digitally, so it states nothing on any aspect.
